contract: project = WHICH INDEX, passed on every call (schema-optional for now); path = WHICH TREE (your working directory: branch checkout / linked worktree); project alone -> alias's registered checkout in its current state; index_codebase: project only (path = first-time registration of a NEW root).

harness.before_texts: schema [RECOMMENDED] project + 'Prefer over project in worktrees' path; prime hint 'project preferred over path'; search-cascade 'path is the default in any checkout, never project alone'; subagent block 'no project needed'.
harness.after_texts: workspace/skill-snapshot/after/ — new schema strings, prime hint, search-cascade Addressing, subagent block with hook alias line, workingTree.project.

audit_findings.description: Three layers contradict: schema + prime say project preferred; search-cascade + skills say path default, never project alone. Agents pick per context -> inconsistent calls.
Subagents never learn the alias (block says 'no project needed'; hook injects nothing).
Answers do not name the index alias, so a path-only caller cannot switch to project.
`tea-rags project exist --path` matches the registry path exactly; a linked worktree or subdirectory misses, so tooling cannot resolve the alias from a cwd.
